shortDescription: Adds five IKEA-themed cosmetic body genes—Kallax, Billy, Lack, Blåhaj, and Frakta variants—to OMW Storageborn Xenotype, grouped into industrial and medieval categories.
body:
## IKEA Storageborn body genes

Requires and loads after OMW Storageborn Xenotype. Defines five `GeneDef`s extending `OMW_StorageBodyBase`: Blåhaj, Frakta, and FraktaRainbow are in the Industrial Ikea category; Kallax, Billy, and Lack are in the Medieval Ikea category. Each assigns the corresponding childhood backstory, supplies the matching body texture paths for all body types through a BigAndSmall pawn extension, and applies the shared Storageborn gene package (including optional Alpha Genes entries). FraktaRainbow additionally forces the Gay trait.

## Categories

Defines Medieval Ikea and Industrial Ikea Storageborn categories with medieval and industrial world tech levels respectively.

## Art

Ships north, south, and east body textures for Blåhaj, Billy, Frakta, FraktaRainbow, Kallax, and Lack. Gene icons point to the corresponding south-facing textures.

## Implementation status and limits

The project file references Harmony and the Storageborn Xenotype assembly, but the current workspace contains no authored C# source, built mod assembly, XML patches, or language key files. Thus the previously described settings menu, Kallax toggle, Harmony spawn-pool override, and enabled-pool fallback behavior are not present in the current authored files and should not be assumed to work.
